title: On Appearing at the door before dark
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：appear　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 appear 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the clerk ① appeared at the door before dark in public, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② appears at the door before dark in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ appear at the door before dark at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ appeared at the door before dark before — a line in the file for May 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Appearing at the door before dark in public, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ appear older than his years in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Appear older than his years at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ appears older than his years in public every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply  appeared at the door before dark again when nobody else would.

To appear at the door before dark, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody appears at the door before dark in silence again and somebody must appear at the door before dark in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 出现（一般过去式 appeared at the door before dark：1975 年书记员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 出现（一般现在 appears at the door before dark：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 出现（不定式 to appear at the door before dark：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 出现（过去完成时 had appeared at the door before dark：1969 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 出现（动名词 appearing at the door before dark 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 显得（appear older than his years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去显得比他年纪更老的样子）
G. v. 显得（appear older than his years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 出现（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 appears older than his years，而母亲又一次 appeared at the door before dark）

items.q: appeared at the door before dark
appears at the door before dark
to appear at the door before dark

appearing at the door before dark

answers.why: appear 意为“出现”，1975 年书记员当着众人面出现天黑前出现在门口，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 appeared。
appear 意为“出现”，自那以后书记员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 appears。
appear 意为“出现”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯出现天黑前出现在门口”，此处为不定式 to appear at the door before dark。
appear 意为“出现”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人出现过，故用过去完成时 had appeared。
appear 意为“出现”，书记员说“出现天黑前出现在门口这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 appearing at the door before dark 作主语。
appear 意为“显得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去显得比他年纪更老的样子”，should ever 之后用原形 appear older than his years。
appear 意为“显得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻显得比他年纪更老的样子（appear older than his years at once），以后再也不要提起。
appear 意为“出现”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例显得比他年纪更老的样子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 appears。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 appear 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the clerk appeared at the door before dark in public, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk appears at the door before dark in silence whenever the office asks.
Appearing at the door before dark in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever appear older than his years in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office appears older than his years in public every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother appeared at the door before dark again, and the office remembered that half.
